rows.name: Container base images
rows.reads: `Dockerfile`, `*.Dockerfile`, `Containerfile`, `compose.yaml`, `docker-compose.yml`: base images of official `node`, `python`, `postgres`, `mysql`, and `ruby`
rows.reports: Image release lines that are end of life. Variables, `latest`, and floating tags are listed as unclassified, never guessed. See [Container base images](docs/detectors/container.md)

rows.name: .NET
rows.reads: `global.json`, `*.csproj`/`*.fsproj`/`*.vbproj`, `Directory.Build.props`, `Directory.Packages.props`, `packages.lock.json`: the pinned SDK, target frameworks, and direct NuGet packages
rows.reports: .NET release lines past end of support, and direct packages their publisher deprecated, with the C# files that use them. .NET Framework, `netstandard`, MSBuild properties, floating versions, and ranges are not judged. See [.NET](docs/detectors/dotnet.md)

rows.name: Go
rows.reads: `go.mod` and `go.work`: `go` and `toolchain` directives, and direct `require` entries
rows.reports: Go release lines that no longer receive fixes, and direct modules with a lifecycle rule. Versions Evergreen cannot read are listed as unclassified. See [Go](docs/detectors/go.md)

rows.name: GitHub Actions
rows.reads: `.github/workflows/*.yml`: `uses:` references to actions, including full-SHA pins resolved through a trailing version comment or a bundled release map
rows.reports: Actions on retired runtimes (such as Node.js 20) and retired or deprecated majors, at the exact line

rows.name: C and C++
rows.reads: `CMakeLists.txt`, `conanfile.txt`, `conanfile.py`, and `vcpkg.json`
rows.reports: CMake policy compatibility removals and deprecations, at the exact declaration. Other declarations require a matching reviewed rule. See [C and C++](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md#c-and-c-detector)

rows.name: CI runner images
rows.reads: `.gitlab-ci.yml` `image` and `services`, `.circleci/config.yml` `docker.image`, `machine.image`, and orbs, and `azure-pipelines.yml` `pool.vmImage`
rows.reports: Azure hosted-image labels a reviewed rule covers, at the exact line. GitLab images and CircleCI orbs, variables, and floating aliases are unclassified. A literal CircleCI image is not judged. See [CI runner images](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md#ci-runner-images-detector)

rows.name: Java and Kotlin (JVM)
rows.reads: `pom.xml`, `build.gradle`, `build.gradle.kts`, `.java-version`, `.sdkmanrc`, `.tool-versions`: the JDK a project pins or targets, and direct Maven dependencies. See [Java and Kotlin](docs/detectors/java.md)
rows.reports: JDK feature releases that are out of support, and dependencies whose POM says they moved. Property references and expressions are listed as unclassified

rows.name: Kubernetes APIs
rows.reads: `*.yaml`, `*.yml` manifests, Helm chart `templates/`, and `kustomization.yaml`: the literal `apiVersion` and `kind`, and kustomize patches. See [Kubernetes APIs](docs/detectors/kubernetes.md)
rows.reports: API versions the Kubernetes project says are no longer served. Helm values, cluster-guarded templates, and anything it cannot read literally are skipped

rows.name: Node.js
rows.reads: `engines.node`, `volta`, `.nvmrc`, `.node-version`
rows.reports: Runtime versions that are end of life or out of support

rows.name: npm
rows.reads: `package.json` dependencies, `package-lock.json`, `npm-shrinkwrap.json`, `yarn.lock`, `pnpm-lock.yaml`, and the imports and calls that use each package
rows.reports: Deprecated or unmaintained packages, with the replacement and where the package is used

rows.name: Deno and Bun
rows.reads: `deno.json`, `deno.jsonc`, `bunfig.toml`, `.bun-version`: exact runtime pins
rows.reports: Deno and Bun release lines past end of life. Version ranges, floating aliases, and environment variables are not matched. See [Deno and Bun](docs/detectors/deno.md)

rows.name: Python
rows.reads: `pyproject.toml`, `requirements*.txt`, `.python-version`, `runtime.txt`, `.tool-versions`, `poetry.lock`, `uv.lock`, `Pipfile.lock`
rows.reports: Python versions that are end of life, and deprecated or obsolete packages

rows.name: Dart and Flutter
rows.reads: `pubspec.yaml`, `pubspec.lock`, `.fvmrc`, `.fvm/fvm_config.json`: SDK constraints, direct dependencies, resolved packages, and the pinned Flutter version
rows.reports: Dart SDK releases that no longer receive security updates when pinned exactly, and discontinued pub packages with the files that use them. Constraint ranges such as `>=3.8.0 <4.0.0` are not judged. See [Dart and Flutter](docs/detectors/dart.md)

rows.name: Elixir and Mix
rows.reads: `.tool-versions`, `mix.exs`, `mix.lock`: pinned Elixir and Erlang/OTP versions, the project `elixir:` constraint, direct Hex dependencies, and resolved packages
rows.reports: Elixir and OTP release lines past end of support and retired Hex packages. See [Elixir and Mix](docs/detectors/elixir.md)

rows.name: Scala and sbt
rows.reads: `.scala-version`, `build.sbt`, `project/build.properties`: pinned Scala versions, literal `scalaVersion` settings, and the sbt version
rows.reports: Scala 2.11, frozen Scala 3.0–3.2 lines, and sbt 0.13. See [Scala and sbt](docs/detectors/scala.md)

rows.name: Database runtimes
rows.reads: `compose.yaml` / `docker-compose.yml` image tags (`postgres`, `mysql`, `mariadb`, `redis`, `mongo`) and `engine_version` on AWS managed database resources in `*.tf`
rows.reports: PostgreSQL 11–13 and MySQL 5.7 and 8.0 past end of life. Floating tags, variables, module blocks, and Compose files with YAML aliases are not judged. See [Database runtimes](docs/detectors/database.md)

rows.name: Shell and PowerShell
rows.reads: `#Requires -Version` in `*.ps1` / `*.psm1`, `PowerShellVersion` in `*.psd1`, and pinned `mcr.microsoft.com/powershell` image tags in `.github/workflows`
rows.reports: PowerShell 6.x and 7.0–7.3 past end of support. Windows PowerShell 5.1, shell names, Bash images, dynamic values, and directives with extra options are not judged. See [Shell and PowerShell](docs/detectors/shell.md)

rows.name: Terraform
rows.reads: `*.tf` (`required_version`, `required_providers`), `.terraform.lock.hcl`, `.terraform-version`, `.tool-versions`: constraints, locked providers, and the pinned Terraform CLI
rows.reports: Terraform CLI release lines that no longer receive support when pinned exactly or by a `~> X.Y.Z` constraint. Ranges such as `>= 1.5` are not judged. See [Terraform](docs/detectors/terraform.md)

rows.name: Rust
rows.reads: `Cargo.toml`, `Cargo.lock`, `rust-toolchain(.toml)`: the pinned toolchain and direct crate dependencies
rows.reports: Toolchains older than the newest stable release, and direct dependencies on unmaintained crates with the files that use them. `edition`, `rust-version`, `stable`, and anything it cannot read literally are not judged. See [Rust](docs/detectors/rust.md)

rows.name: Swift
rows.reads: `.swift-version`, `.xcode-version`, `Package.swift`, `Package.resolved`, and the application-target `IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET` in `project.pbxproj`
rows.reports: Xcode and iOS releases App Store Connect no longer accepts, Swift toolchain lines with a lifecycle rule, and packages with a rule. Libraries and `platforms:` minimums are not judged. See [Swift](docs/detectors/swift.md)

rows.name: Serverless runtimes
rows.reads: `Runtime` in AWS SAM and CloudFormation templates, `provider.runtime` and `runtime` in `serverless.yml`, and `runtime` in Terraform `aws_lambda_function`, Google Cloud Functions, and Azure function apps
rows.reports: Lambda and Cloud Functions runtimes their vendor lists as end of life. See [Serverless runtimes](docs/detectors/serverless.md)

rows.name: Ruby
rows.reads: `.ruby-version`, `.tool-versions`, `Gemfile`, `Gemfile.lock`
rows.reports: Ruby release lines past end of support and yanked gems, with the Ruby files that use a gem. See [Compatibility](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md#ruby-detector)

rows.name: PHP
rows.reads: `.php-version`, `.tool-versions`, `composer.json`, `composer.lock`
rows.reports: PHP release lines past end of support and abandoned Composer packages. See [Compatibility](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md#php-detector)

rows.name: Android
rows.reads: `build.gradle(.kts)`, `settings.gradle(.kts)`, `libs.versions.toml`: SDK levels, Android Gradle Plugin, Kotlin plugin, and Maven dependencies
rows.reports: Declarations that a reviewed rule names, such as Google Play Billing Library majors 5 through 9. See [Compatibility](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md#android-detector)
